extracted.intended_audience: Investigators and grant support staff preparing NIH PHS 398 (e.g., SBIR) applications — PD/PIs, senior/key personnel, and institutional grants administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the Biographical Sketch, Current/Active Support, and Research & Related Budget (Sections A–K) for an NIH PHS 398 application (including subaward/consortium attachments and budget justification).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — format and length
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the required labeled sections (A–D) for each person and adhere strictly to the four-page maximum. Use the specified fields (NAME, POSITION TITLE, eRA COMMONS USER NAME).

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training section (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable.) — INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE (if applicable); MM/YY; FIELD OF STUDY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List institutions chronologically beginning with undergraduate. Provide degree, month/year and field for each entry as shown (e.g., Bryn Mawr College A.B. 1960 Biology).

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Statement of research interests specific to this proposal (summary of the investigator's goals, relevance to the current proposal, and key qualifications/experience).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the goal of your research as it relates to the application, relevant prior accomplishments (reagents, methods, solved structures, collaborations), unique resources (panels of monoclonal antibodies, sample collections), and how your expertise/previous work supports success on the proposed project. Use concrete examples (techniques, sample sizes, preliminary findings) to demonstrate fit and capability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Employment (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: Chronological listing of positions and employment (titles, institutions, and dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include academic and research appointments (with dates) demonstrating career trajectory and current role (e.g., Professor of Microbiology). This section supports demonstration of qualifications and sustained research activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selected peer–reviewed publications (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: Selected peer–reviewed publications most relevant to the current application (from the applicant's body of work).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose publications most directly relevant to the proposed work. Include complete citations and PMCID where available. Do not attempt to list all publications—selectivity is expected (examples show selection from >170).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support (biosketch/other support)
rubrics_metrics.description: List ongoing and completed research support with Dates, Grant Number, PI/Co-Investigator roles, Funding Institute, Title, and a brief statement of the project's major focus and relation to the current application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each entry include dates, funder (NIH/NIAID etc.), project title, major focus/aims, and an explicit statement about scientific/budget overlap (e.g., 'No overlap' or 'No overlap (or less than 10% in science, non in budget)'). Distinguish ongoing vs completed support (past 3 years).

rubrics_metrics.name: Current and Pending / Other Support reporting rules
rubrics_metrics.description: For New and Renewal Applications (PHS 398) submit required Other Support; for Non-competing Progress Reports (PHS 2590) submit only Active Support for Key Personnel; include active and pending entries that document calendar month commitments and potential overlap.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report all active support and pending proposals for key personnel, showing calendar-month effort (e.g., 3.6 calendar months), title, goals, and any overlap statements. Include separate subaward/consortium organizational entries with DUNS, start/end dates, and their budgets when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of overlap / conflict with other projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicitly state overlap (scientific or budgetary) between listed projects and the current application (examples: 'No overlap with any herpes projects listed above.'; 'No overlap (or less than 10% in science, non in budget)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each listed grant or support item clearly disclose whether there is overlap in aims, personnel effort, or budget with the proposed work. Quantify overlap when appropriate (<10% etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section A — Senior/Key Person fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Senior/Key Person: collect prefix, first/middle/last name, project role, base salary, calendar months, academic months, summer months, requested salary ($), fringe benefits ($), funds requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide requested salary and fringe for each senior/key person, and sum 'Total Funds Requested for all Senior Key Persons' in the file. List additional senior key persons with file attachments as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section B — Other Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Personnel: specify number of personnel, project role, calendar months, academic months, summer months, requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested for categories (postdocs, graduate students, undergraduates, secretarial/clerical, programmers, application scientists, research specialists, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide counts and dollar totals for each category and compute totals for 'Total Other Personnel' and 'Total Salary, Wages and Fringe Benefits (A+B)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section C — Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Equipment Description: List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000; report 'Total funds requested for all equipment listed'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize each piece of equipment > $5,000 with cost and include a running total. If none, enter 0.00. Attach supporting files if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section D — Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: Travel: Itemize and request funds for domestic travel (including Canada, Mexico, U.S. possessions) and foreign travel costs, and provide totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide justification in the Budget Justification for travel (e.g., meetings, collaborations). Separate domestic and foreign travel lines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section E — Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Participant/Trainee Support Costs: broken down into Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other, and number of participants/trainees with totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If supporting trainees or participants, provide per-category estimates and participant counts; otherwise enter 0.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section F — Other Direct Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Direct Costs: provide funds requested for Materials and Supplies, Publication Costs, Consultant Services, ADP/Computer Services, Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, Alterations and Renovations, and other specified line items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize predicted direct costs; include subaward amounts and other category subtotals. Use the Budget Justification to explain major items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section H — Indirect Costs (F&A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested ($); include cognizant federal agency contact information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the institution's negotiated F&A rate (e.g., 'MTA 40.0' or 'Research 61.0') and indicate which bases are excluded (equipment, subcontracts per policy). Provide POC for cognizant federal agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section I — Total Direct and Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Total Direct Costs (G) and Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H) for the budget period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure arithmetic consistency across A–H and that totals match the attached budget justification and cumulative budget pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section J — Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee: request a fee amount (if applicable) to cover allowable business costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If requesting a fee (e.g., for an SBIR), justify its size in the Budget Justification (example: 'A fee of less than 7% is requested').

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section K — Budget Justification attachment rules
rubrics_metrics.description: K. Budget Justification: attach one file (Budget Justification PDF) that explains personnel effort, fringe, travel, supplies, indirect costs, and fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only attach one file; include file name and MIME type. The justification should detail senior personnel months and roles, fringe benefit assumptions (example ~25%), travel amounts & purpose, supply categories, subaward details, and explanation of the indirect cost rate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — content expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain requested support for Senior Personnel (months and supervisory roles), Engineers/Technicians, Fringe Benefits, Travel, Supplies, Equipment testing fees, Indirect Costs and Fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide explicit effort months for personnel (e.g., 'Two months support is requested for the PI'), percent/amount estimates for fringe (~25% example), travel amounts (e.g., $5,000), supplies and what they will be used for, costs for external testing/consulting, and an explanation of the institution's indirect cost rate and fee rationale (e.g., IP costs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward / Consortium budgeting and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: When including subawards/consortium organizations (e.g., The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania, Dartmouth College), provide their separate A–K RESEARCH & RELATED budget pages, requested funds, personnel listings, and indirect cost rates; include organizational DUNS and start/end dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat subawards as separate line items with their own detailed budgets and justifications. Provide travel, equipment, and personnel details for each subaward and indicate whether their costs overlap with the prime proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative budget totals reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide cumulative budget totals across Sections A–J, summarizing Senior/Key Person, Other Personnel, Equipment, Travel, Participant Support, Other Direct Costs, Direct Costs subtotal, Indirect Costs, Total Direct and Indirect Costs, and Fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the cumulative totals appear on summary pages and reconcile with line-item pages and the Budget Justification attachments.
